gloss_en: the festival's proclaiming and calling out of the Divine Will — each Yom Tov announces and reveals that everything is governed solely by God's will, in the aspect of 'mikra kodesh' (holy convocation, Lev. 23), read as 'the holy one calls out/proclaims' the Will (LM II:4)
canonical_he: מכריז וקורא את הרצון בבחינת מקרא קדש
